Your trusted partner in health

It's our mission to help you live your healthiest life possible. That means we're not just here for you when you're sick. We also offer personalized guidance and support to help you stay well.

We're reimagining healthcare

At Intermountain Health, we’re reimagining the way we deliver care by taking a proactive approach to help you stay well. And when it comes to the moments that matter most, you can trust that we have the expertise, most advanced technology, and best treatment options to get you back to doing the things you love.

About us

Intermountain Children's Health

From your family pediatrician to our specialty caregivers, at Intermountain Children’s Health we’re here to partner for the care your family needs. And by combining our expertise with yours, together, we’ll collaborate towards your child’s complete well-being.

Learn more

Careers at Intermountain Health

Discover your career at Intermountain Health where you’ll find inspiration, flexibility, employment stability, benefits, and a lifetime of challenging career opportunities. Join the Intermountain team and begin your rewarding career today.
